parameters.name: UploadSuccessful
parameters.description: A counter representing the total number of successful file uploads across all transfer tasks since the last system reset or counter reset.

parameters.name: UploadFailed
parameters.description: A counter representing the total number of failed file uploads across all transfer tasks since the last system reset or counter reset.

object.description: This object provides aggregated statistical information about all file upload activities managed by the {{object|Device.PeriodicFileTransfer.}} object.
